# Boiling Snow (沸腾之雪) - LLMs Discovery Guide

> **Project Identity**: AI-Native Realistic Wuxia Micro-movie Production System.
> **Philosophy**: Physics-based action, 35mm film grain, Low-key lighting, Realistic high-martial-arts (Realistic Wuxia).

## 🎬 Core Strategy
- **Visual**: No magic circles, no glowing runes. Every movement must have a physical impact (snow dust, wall cracks, fabric physics).
- **Ranking**: The "Tianbang" (God Ranking) defines the power balance (10 masters).
- **Production**: All scenes are segmented into 15s clips following the [0-4s: Breath | 4-10s: Impact | 10-15s: Aftermath] structure.

## 📁 Critical Files for AI Context
- `agents/`: The unified Creation Center. Contains rules, prompt libraries, and templates.
- `bibles/WORLD.md`: The SSOT for world-building and ranking logic.
- `cast/`: Character data in JSON format.

## 👤 Key Characters & Ranking
- Detailed profiles and Tianbang (God Ranking) are managed in [bibles/WORLD.md](bibles/WORLD.md) and [cast/](cast/).
- Refer to [agents/README.md](agents/README.md) for the unified creation center.

## 🛠️ AI Production Red Lines
- **Strictly NO subtitles/watermarks** in visual descriptions.
- **Strictly NO modern elements**.
- **Combat**: Must follow "Windup -> Path -> Impact -> Recovery" loop.
